title: Dr. M. P. Phaniraj appointed as Director of Research and Development Committee at MGIT - MGIT
content:
## Dr. M. P. Phaniraj appointed as Director of Research and Development Committee at MGIT

News Date : 25 Feb 2023News ReportMGIT is pleased to announce the appointment of Dr. M. P. Phaniraj as the Director of the Research and Development Committee. Dr. Phaniraj is an accomplished associate professor in the Department of Metallurgical and Materials Engineering (MME) at MGIT, with a wealth of experience and knowledge in the field.The appointment of Dr. Phaniraj as the Director of the Research and Development Committee is a testament to his dedication and commitment to the college’s mission and vision. In this new role, Dr. Phaniraj will be responsible for leading and overseeing the research and development activities at MGIT.The Department of MME congratulates Dr. Phaniraj on his appointment and wishes him all the best in this new endeavor. We are confident that under his leadership, the research and development activities at MGIT will continue to flourish and make significant contributions to the academic and research community.We look forward to working closely with Dr. Phaniraj and the Research and Development Committee to further advance the college’s research capabilities and achieve our shared goals.
